Indication animations

Source: R/composition.R
indication.Rd

Animations that draw attention to a mobject or point.

Usage

FocusOn(focus_point, opacity = 0.2, color = GREY, run_time = 2, ...)

Indicate(
  mobject,
  scale_factor = 1.2,
  color = PURE_YELLOW,
  rate_func = there_and_back,
  ...
)

ShowPassingFlash(mobject, time_width = 0.1, ...)

Flash(
  point,
  line_length = 0.2,
  num_lines = 12,
  flash_radius = 0.1,
  line_stroke_width = 3,
  color = PURE_YELLOW,
  time_width = 1,
  run_time = 1,
  ...
)

ShowPassingFlashWithThinningStrokeWidth(
  vmobject,
  n_segments = 10,
  time_width = 0.1,
  remover = TRUE,
  ...
)

ApplyWave(
  mobject,
  direction = UP,
  amplitude = 0.2,
  wave_func = smooth_rate,
  time_width = 1,
  ripples = 1,
  run_time = 2,
  ...
)

Wiggle(
  mobject,
  scale_value = 1.1,
  rotation_angle = 0.01 * TAU,
  n_wiggles = 6,
  scale_about_point = NULL,
  rotate_about_point = NULL,
  run_time = 2,
  ...
)

Circumscribe(
  mobject,
  shape = c("rectangle", "circle"),
  fade_in = FALSE,
  fade_out = FALSE,
  time_width = 0.3,
  buff = SMALL_BUFF,
  color = PURE_YELLOW,
  run_time = 1,
  stroke_width = DEFAULT_STROKE_WIDTH,
  ...
)

Blink(
  mobject,
  time_on = 0.5,
  time_off = 0.5,
  blinks = 1,
  hide_at_end = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

focus_point, point

Point or mobject to focus or flash on.

opacity

Opacity of the focusing spotlight.

color

Color.

run_time

Duration.

...

Passed on to the underlying animation.

mobject, vmobject

The mobject to indicate.

scale_factor

Scale at the peak.

rate_func

Rate function.

time_width

Width of the traveling flash, as a fraction of the path.

line_length, num_lines, flash_radius, line_stroke_width

Flash geometry.

n_segments

Number of strokes for the thinning flash.

remover

Remove when done.

direction, amplitude, wave_func, ripples

Wave settings.

scale_value, rotation_angle, n_wiggles, scale_about_point, rotate_about_point

Wiggle settings.

shape

"rectangle" or "circle" for Circumscribe().

fade_in, fade_out

Fade the frame in or out.

buff

Buffer around the mobject.

stroke_width

Stroke width.

time_on, time_off, blinks, hide_at_end

Blink settings.

Value

An animation: an R6 object of the class named by the function called, to pass to a scene's play(). The objects whose names end in Class are the R6 class generators that these functions call.
